manifest.author: AIBAST
manifest.description: Audits time entries and tracks receivables from a live simulated Dynamics 365 tenant invoice ledger, with an offline demo fallback.
manifest.name: @aibast-agents-library/time_entry_billing

entry_id.description: Time-entry identifier, such as TE-9004; selects its exception-resolution record.

operation.description: Operation to run; defaults to unbilled_report when omitted.

record_id.description: Evidence record identifier for exception_resolution or billing_close_package, such as TEB-701 or TEB-CLOSE-701.
